out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. OBSERVED 2026 HEALTH PERMIT NOT POSTED.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. POST PERMIT INA CONSPICUOUS LOCATION. CONTACT [county email] OR CALL 703-246-2201 TO INQUIRE ABOUT HAVING A COPY MAILED TO YOU.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED BOXES OF EGGS AND BUTTER STORED ON FLOOR OF WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM WILL MOVE FOODS TO SHELVES.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. CFM COULD NOT LOCATED BLEACH TEST STRIPS DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: PURCHASE A BLEACH TEST KIT. EHS PROVIDED CFM BLEACH TEST STRIPS.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CFM must be present during all hours of operation. CFM is out of town and will return Monday.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw shell eggs on top shelf of WIC above RTE icings and baked cupcakes.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC moved raw shell eggs to bottom shelf.
